fact: TMPV and Stellantis sign definitive agreement adding technology and product development to their partnership
Vehicles developed under the deal will be made in India for more than 50 global markets
TMPV gives Stellantis access to its product technology and vehicle architecture
Vehicles will be manufactured at FIAPL, the 50:50 TMPV-Stellantis joint venture
Agreement follows a February MoU on manufacturing, engineering and supply chains
Companies expect the tie-up to expand exports and strengthen India’s role in global production
Tata raises Iveco offer by 2% to €14.40 per share as three key investors hold out
Tata says €14.40 is its best and final offer and will not raise it further
Price increase follows Petrus Advisers’ rejection of the original offer and delays in regulatory approvals
Tender acceptances stood at 28.4%; offer deadline is 26 October
Hedge funds Davidson Kempner and Syquant Capital, and activist investor Petrus Advisers hold 20.4% combined and have not tendered
Revised offer increases deal value by about €81 million from the original €3.8 billion
note: €81 million increase in deal value is not stated in P.

fact: Tata Motors PV delivered over 50,000 vehicles during Navratri, including more than 10,000 on Dussehra
Total vehicle retail sales fall 6.52% YoY to 11,23,086 units from 12,01,479 units
Passenger vehicle retail sales fall 22% YoY to 1,82,728 units from 2,34,004 units
Two-wheeler retail sales fall about 3% YoY to 8,34,075 units from 8,58,027 units
Commercial vehicle sales rise marginally to 35,618 units from 35,224 units
FADA says decline reflects an 11-day versus 10-day Navratri and the GST 2.0 demand surge last year
Tata Motors PV says demand was robust across its multi-powertrain cars and SUVs, with higher showroom walk-ins and bookings
EV retail sales grow about 27% YoY to 1,17,437 units from 92,628 units
